name: Neophytes
overview: Scripture reveals that neophytes, or new believers, require spiritual nourishment suited to their capacity, as Jesus taught in parables appropriate for their understanding and withheld deeper truths until they were ready (Mark 4:33; John 16:4, 12). The apostle Paul emphasizes this by describing new Christians as babes in Christ, feeding them with milk rather than solid food because they were not yet able to handle more advanced teaching (1 Corinthians 3:1-2). Additionally, mature believers are cautioned to exercise their freedom carefully so as not to cause weaker believers to stumble, underscoring the responsibility toward those still growing in faith (1 Corinthians 8:9).
